module: Experimental 'boost' extension: simulates a force on the vehicle by placing very distant negative-mass 'planets' (obj:setPlanets), which pushes the vehicle in a given direction for a limited time. A call to boost(force, dt) adds a push that lasts dt seconds.
notes: For each push, a planet is placed at (vehicle position - force * 1000) with radius 10 and mass -1e18; obj:setPlanets receives the full list every frame.

BUG: in updateGFX, `table.remove(boosts, i)` uses a variable `i` that does not exist (ipairs is written `_, boost`). When a push expires, the call receives nil and raises a Lua error; moreover removing during iteration skips an element.
updateGFX prints (print) the planet list every frame as long as there is at least one push: log noise.
When the list is empty, obj:setPlanets({}) is still called every frame.

boost.desc: Adds a push: the direction/force is given by a vector, dt is its duration.

force.desc: Push vector (converted to vec3); it is multiplied by 1000 to place the planet.

updateGFX.desc: Called every frame: updates lifetimes, builds the planet list and applies it with obj:setPlanets.
